title: 2권 3유닛 장면 · 1
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. One single continuous picture: never split it into panels, frames or a collage, and draw each character only once. No humans or human children anywhere in the picture; every creature is an animal (Fairy E is the only fairy). Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Beads. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: The bank of the Word Pond is full of flapping brown hens with red combs — ten of them — running in every direction with feathers flying. A butterfly net with a wooden handle lies on the sand; high above, a white jet plane draws a vapor trail across the sky. Bun points at the net; Pip, trying to say the word, has shouted it backwards and now stares at all the hens that came running; Hedgie covers his head; Beads peeks from a lily pad. Hidden in the picture: the net, a hen, exactly ten (10) hens — count them, ten hens, no more and no fewer —, the jet. Grumble does NOT appear. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small round hedgehog with BRIGHT ORANGE spikes (never brown), a peach-colored face and cream belly, standing on two legs, one tiny blue flower stuck in the spikes, curious cautious eyes. Beads is a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads.
